testcase.name: notes enter the snapshot only when the layout has a note area
the revision is stable for the same paper and changes with its content
the host paper id is stable for the same ticket and bounded for long tickets
a preview can only be adopted on the exact paper it was generated from
whitelisted commands produce a preview without touching the source paper
a cancelled task is reported as cancelled and keeps the paper
an illegal or out-of-range command rejects the whole batch and keeps the paper
an unknown question id is rejected instead of guessed
every block kind maps to the bounded snapshot shape
a model failure keeps the paper and does not echo the provider message as a receipt
the snapshot carries bounded paper text and never a local image location
a blank required text blocks the request before any model task
commands that change nothing are not reported as applied
an empty command list is not a success receipt
an input that cannot be represented is rejected before the port runs
the app consent value is forwarded as given and never hardcoded
a blank instruction and an over-budget instruction are rejected before the port runs
